{{Quote|A single Trade Federation battleship. Looks to be a carrier, not very well armed.''"<br />"''<nowiki />''One'' ship? That seems suspect.|Dron and Keelyvine Reus|<ref name="AoI" />}}
A '''''Lucrehulk''-class battleship''' was used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] to carry out the operation known as [[Project Instinction]] on behalf of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. It transported [[Seismic tank/Legends|seismic tanks]] loaded up with [[Badlands (Moorja)|badlands]] soil on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]], alongside three [[Project Instinction device|neural broadcast transmitters]], to the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]].

Instead of directly threatening the planet's [[Planetary shield/Legends|deflector shields]], the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|battleship]] used the seismic [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] to deploy the soil particles onto that same [[Deflector shield/Legends|energy barrier]], to which they adhered and, remaining aligned with [[Ukio system's star|Ukio's sun]], thereby blocked sunlight from reaching the planet's [[Plant/Legends|crops]]. Once the patrolling [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] force realized the Confederate plan, it engaged the [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] and ultimately destroyed it, albeit not before its [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] had carried the neural broadcast transmitters to Ukio's surface, where they were used to induce a state of heightened aggression in various lifeforms.

==Description==
{{Quote|That Separatist battleship is jamming most frequencies.|Dron|<ref name="AoI" />}}
A [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]<ref name="AoI" /> was manufactured by [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]], measuring 3,170 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in diameter.<ref name="DB" /> It featured three<ref name="AoI" /> [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] [[Proton 2/Legends|Proton 2]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]]<ref name="Data" /> as well as six<ref name="AoI" /> [[Proton 12]] drives from the same manufacturer.<ref name="Data" /> The [[Battleship/Legends|battleship's]] [[Core ship/Legends|core ship]] section<ref name="AoI" /> featured a scanner array.<ref name="Data" /> Although there were at least forty-two [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] placements on the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] ring carrier section, it was nevertheless characterized as "not very well armed" by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] [[Dron]] and its offensive capabilities were considered by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Keelyvine Reus]] to be insufficient on their own to pose a threat to the [[Planetary shield/Legends|deflector shields]] protecting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. The ship could function as a [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]], however.<ref name="AoI" />

The battleship also possessed equipment allowing it to [[Jammer/Legends|jam]] most of the communication frequencies used by Republic military starships. Its [[Hull/Legends|hull]] featured dark [[Color/Legends|blue]] markings and was emblazoned with<ref name="AoI" /> the [[Separatist hex icon/Legends|insignia]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CV2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'', 2016 edition]]</ref> The starship complement of the battleship included at least seventeen [[Seismic tank/Legends|seismic tanks]] and three [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttles]], and a number of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droid]] [[Droid starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were stored in its ring carrier.<ref name="AoI" />

==History==
===A puzzling arrival===
{{Quote|A lure to pull us to the other side of the planet?''"<br />"''Possibly. It's not enough to threaten Ukio's shields.|Kit Fisto and Keelyvine Reus|<ref name="AoI" />}}
[[File:Moorja_badlands.png|thumb|right|300px|Seismic tanks being loaded with badlands soil on Moorja]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] served with the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|naval forces]] of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. At one point, [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI" /> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], and his<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref> [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droid]] [[Doctor (tactical droid)|Doctor]] carried out [[Project Instinction]], an operation aiming to bring<ref name="AoI" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural planet]] Ukio under the control of the Confederacy. To that end,<ref name="AoI" /> around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> they had modified seismic [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] loaded up with [[Badlands (Moorja)|badlands]] soil&mdash;an electrostatic material with photoreactive properties&mdash;on<ref name="AoI" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] planet<ref name="Journal8">{{JournalCite|8|Black Curs Blues}}</ref> [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]], after which the ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship carried the seismic tanks as well as Doctor and three [[Project Instinction device|neural broadcast transmitters]] to the [[Ukio system/Legends|Ukio system]].<ref name="AoI" />

[[File:ProjectInstinctionPhase1-ActOnInstinct.png|thumb|left|300px|The seismic tanks carried by the ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship deployed the badlands soil onto the planetary shields of Ukio.]]
At Ukio, the battleship's presence was detected by the planet's [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] network, which sent an over-the-horizon [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] alert that reached both Ukio's [[Ukian government|government]] and the patrolling Galactic Republic [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] force. Puzzled by the apparent lack of a real threat to Ukio posed by the lone battleship, the Republic [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Keelyvine Reus and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] approached the vessel in [[Keelyvine Reus's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor|their]] [[Kit Fisto's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptors]] to reconnoiter it. They then observed the battleship launch its seismic tanks toward the nearby planet's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and deploy their payload of the Moorja soil onto it. While the battleship was jamming the Republic's communications frequencies, the two Jedi in their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] unsuccessfully attempted to thwart the still-mysterious Confederate plan by blowing up some of the seismic tanks.<ref name="AoI" />

===Separatist plans===
{{Quote|Liege, there is a Separatist ship in orbit that has introduced an occluding element into your atmosphere.|Keelyvine Reus|<ref name="AoI" />}}
[[File:RepublicAttackOnLucrehulk-ActOnInstinct.png|thumb|right|300px|A Galactic Republic fleet eventually attacked and destroyed the battleship.]]
The Republic force subsequently identified the material being dropped onto Ukio's shields, allowing them to realize that the Separatists intended to create an artificial occultation of [[Ukio system's star|Ukio's sun]] that would cling to the shields and stay aligned with the [[Star/Legends|star]], thereby preventing the planet's [[Plant/Legends|crops]] from accessing sunlight. In a communication with [[Unidentified liege|Ukio's liege]], Reus relayed to them the role the Separatist battleship was playing in the Confederate plot, and she and Fisto then led the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]&mdash;which consisted of at least two [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and at least two [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|''Consular''-class cruisers]] along with their [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]] complement&mdash;in [[Battle of Ukio|attacking]] the Confederate vessel while Ukio's shields were briefly deactivated in order to disperse the soil particles. The battleship held back its complement of vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]] until the shields under the patch of soil were dropped, after which they were released to engage the Republic force.<ref name="AoI" />

Meanwhile, a trio of ''Sheathipede''-class transport [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] carrying Doctor and the three neural broadcast transmitters from the battleship slipped through the opening in Ukio's shields and landed on the planet's surface. There, the broadcast sent out by the transmitters began causing various lifeforms to behave with heightened aggression. Eventually, the Republic force was able to destroy the battleship, with multiple explosions engulfing various sections of the ship, and on Ukio's surface the Jedi likewise destroyed the transmitters; however, the Confederacy ultimately achieved its overarching goal of using the financial instability resulting from the battle at Ukio to purchase the planet.<ref name="AoI" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Federationbattleship.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Artwork used in ''The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct'' to depict the ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship shared similarities with a promotional image (pictured) of a ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship from ''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith''.]]
The ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the [[2009]]<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="AoI announcement" />

In one panel of the comic, the artwork used to depict the battleship shared similarities with<ref name="AoI" /> a promotional image of a ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship from<ref name="SithSnapshots">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/explore/sithsnap/2006/03/sithsnap20060301.html|text=''Sith'' Snapshots: Flying Separatist Colors}}</ref> the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> In three other panels, it was erroneously depicted with<ref name="AoI" /> the transmission antennas present on ''Lucrehulk''-class battleships that had been modified to serve as control ships for droid [[Army/Legends|armies]] instead of as battleships.<ref name="CV2016" />
